notes: Verified history: Octree Software founded 1986 by Roman Ormandy; Caligari Corporation formed 1993; trueSpace shipped on Windows from 1994. Microsoft acquired Caligari in February 2008 and released trueSpace 7.6 as freeware in July 2008; officially discontinued May 2009. License is proprietary-freeware. A leaked ts4 source circulates in piracy channels and is do-not-redistribute for this archive.
